bullets.text: BT Launches Sovereign Platform - **BT** introduces a new platform for UK businesses to enhance data control and network sovereignty.
ISPs Must Add Value - **Incognito** highlights the need for ISPs to offer value-added services to retain customers.
Virgin Media Fined £23.8m - **Ofcom** penalizes **Virgin Media** for endangering vulnerable customers during digital landline migration.
Cloudflare Outage Exposes Risks - Recent outages reveal vulnerabilities in enterprise infrastructure reliance on few providers.
Wi-Fi 8 and AI Integration - The future of **Wi-Fi** focuses on reliability, with **AI** enhancing performance management.
AWS Targets Sovereign AI Market - **AWS** launches AI Factories, challenging telcos in the sovereign AI space.
Telcos Embrace AI-as-a-Service - Telecom operators are transitioning to offer **AI** solutions alongside traditional connectivity.
Automated Threats Shape Security - The rise of automated attacks necessitates a shift in enterprise security strategies.
Vodacom Acquires Majority in Safaricom - **Vodacom** secures a 55% stake in **Safaricom**, enhancing its market position.
Keysight's New RF Analyzers - **Keysight** launches D-Series FieldFox analyzers for enhanced field testing precision.
